name: Look up member savings balance
description: Logs into LegacyBank, searches for a member by ID, and reads their current savings balance. Read-only -- no state is changed.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: The member ID to look up, e.g. '12345'.

outputs.name: savings_balance
outputs.description: The member's current savings balance as displayed, including the '$' sign.

steps.locator_rationale: No <label> element exists for this field in the legacy markup; the visible 'Username' text is a plain table cell, not a real label. Targeting via the adjacent-cell structural match is the only viable strategy.
Same reasoning as the Username field -- no real <label> exists.
This is a real <button>/submit control; its visible text IS its accessible name, so role+name targeting is robust here.
No real <label> exists for the search field, same as the login fields.
Real button control; visible text is its accessible name.

success_checkpoint.description: This heading only appears on a successfully rendered member detail page. The not-found, permission-denied, and session-expired pages each render distinct text instead, so this heading's presence reliably distinguishes real success from every other outcome we've observed.
